kilocode.note: Free models also work with NO auth as a plain row: base https://api.kilo.ai/api/openrouter, model kilo-auto/free. Alt gateway: https://ai-gateway.kilo.ai/api/v1 (also verified).

omnirush.label: OmniRush
omnirush.note: Translator implemented natively 2026-11-18 (api_mode omnirush): POST /responses only, forced stream:true + store:false, NO x-omnirush-session-id, User-Agent omnirush + X-OmniRush-Client cli/<npm-latest>, typed input array, rotating refresh at <control-plane>/device/refresh persisted to oauth.json. Version resolved lazily from registry.npmjs.org/omnirush/latest (live 3.0.1). routable:false until a human device approval proves a real completion; account-signout/ban risk on shared tokens.

opencode.note: SIDELINED 2026-11-18 per Moon: free Zen models are client-locked (429 FreeUsageLimitError to every non-OpenCode client, UA/header spoof does not bypass); paid/OpenCode Go only. Device flow itself is real. Not a working free OAuth preset - do not advertise as one-word connect.

inference.label: Inference.sh
inference.note: Added 2026-11-18. Device flow VERIFIED live: POST {} -> real device_code+user_code; GET /device/auth/poll/{code} -> 200 {"status":"pending"}. Base is /models/openai (chat at /models/openai/chat/completions, Bearer token). Agent could not complete browser approval, so token->completion path is UNVERIFIED. Keep in mind: requires one human approval before it routes; no client-fingerprint gate found in source. Models from official OpenAI-compat docs (namespace/name). Chat at /models/openai/chat/completions, Bearer token, scope apps:execute.

nous.label: Nous Portal
nous.note: Added 2026-11-18 from primary-source research. Device flow form-encoded; refresh secret travels in x-nous-refresh-token header and is SINGLE-USE (persist rotated token). Token is a plain Bearer JWT on the OpenAI-compatible inference API. Free plan = 4 zero-priced :free models (listed); purchased credits needed for paid models. x402 challenge without a token.

zcode.label: ZCode (z.ai plan lane)
zcode.note: Added 2026-11-18 from primary-source research. Free Start Plan grants live-probe: 3M tok/day GLM-5.3 + 5M/day GLM-5.3-Flash (GET /api/v1/client/configs is unauthenticated). Device flow: POST /api/v1/oauth/cli/init with a client-minted 64-hex Bearer + body {provider:zai} -> flow_id + authorize_url; poll GET /api/v1/oauth/cli/poll/<flow_id> with the same Bearer. Plan lane is Anthropic-Messages only (all OpenAI routes 404) and requires the 3-block identity system + X-ZCode-*/X-OS-* headers + metadata.user_id JSON string; missing identity -> 405 code 3012 (captcha/WAF, account-state dependent). Translator implemented natively (api_mode zcode). routable:false until one real login + completion.
